observations: Photo 0 shows a wooden shelf stacked with many used automotive engine mounts and mounting brackets.
Parts show heavy surface rust, oxidation, and grime consistent with used/salvaged stock.
Rubber bushings on some mounts appear cracked or degraded; some brackets show pitting.
Faint painted text on one mount is illegible enough to identify a brand or part number.
A watermark reading 'KINGSLEY IBEH' overlays the image, seller/shop branding, not part identification.
No vehicle, VIN, or part-number tag is visible to match mounts to a specific car model.

identity.kind: assorted used engine mounts / engine mounting brackets

claims.claim: For engine seating and engine mounting
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows generic mounts but no vehicle fitment data or test to confirm functional seating performance.

risks.risk: Rubber bushing integrity (cracked, torn, or perished rubber would fail to dampen engine vibration)
risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of each mount's rubber bushing from multiple angles, flexed by hand.

risks.risk: Vehicle/engine compatibility (mounts are make/model specific; no tags or part numbers visible)
risks.proof: Clear photo of any stamped part number or a photo matched against the buyer's vehicle make/model/year.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unmatched generic scrap-grade stock, not guaranteed fit

risks.risk: Corrosion depth on metal bracket (surface rust vs structural weakening)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of bracket edges and mounting holes showing metal thickness/pitting.

risks.risk: Completeness of hardware (bolts, sleeves, washers) needed for installation
risks.proof: Photo of each mount with its full bolt/hardware set laid out.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, hardware not included

risks.risk: Quantity and exact items being sold (pile contains dozens of mixed mounts, unclear what buyer actually receives)
risks.proof: Itemized photo list or count confirming which specific units are included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unspecified unit, not the full pile

proof_requests: Photo of any stamped part number or brand marking on a specific mount intended for sale.
Close-up of the rubber bushing on the specific unit being sold, showing no cracks or tears.
Confirmation of exact vehicle make/model/year this mount is claimed to fit.
Photo of complete hardware (bolts, sleeves) included with the unit.
Clarification on how many units are being sold and which exact pieces from the pile.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as used engine mounts/brackets, but condition shows rust and no fitment proof, so it must be priced at worst case as corroded, unverified-fit salvage parts until compatibility and bushing condition are shown.
